channel.title: 9nth Dimension
channel.description: The parts of the Bible most churches skip: lost texts, prophecy, Old Testament mysteries and how the canon was formed, told straight, with the references, so you can go deeper in your faith.

item.title: What to do when prayer feels dry
item.description: Dry prayer is a normal stage of spiritual growth, not a sign that God is gone. Here's why it happens and five practical ways to keep praying through it.
